# Lab News

<p class="cgm-page-lead">Research updates, conference presentations, and publications.</p>

::: {.cgm-page-body}

### 2026

[Presentation] November 2026 — Environmental Science students Gabby Westerfiled, Maggie Derbyshire, and Gabby Beemer are presenting their research on beach wrack and dune ecology at the [Southeastern Division of American Association of Geogrphers (SEDAAG)](https://sedaag.org/2026-meeting-information/) conference in Tuscaloosa, Alabama.

[Presentation] July 2026 — Lab co-director Dr. Phillip Schmutz presented research on beach wrack, wind reduction, and sediment deposition at the [International Conference on Aeolian Research (ICAR)](https://www.geog.ox.ac.uk/events/icar2026/index.html) in Swakopmund, Namibia.
  
  - [ICAR 2026 Poster](files/ICAR_Poster_2026.pdf)

[Publication] January 2026 — Paper accepted in *Southeastern Geographer*, Space–Time Mapping and Identification of Sea Turtle Nesting Clusters on Pensacola Beach and Gulf Islands National Seashore, Florida. [https://doi.org/10.1353/sgo.0.a981639](https://doi.org/10.1353/sgo.0.a981639)  



### 2025

[Presentation] December 2025 — Lab co-director Dr. Phillip Schmutz along with students Angelina Scamardo and Dru Adams presented research at the [American Geophysical Union (AGU) Fall Meeting](https://www.agu.org/Fall-Meeting) in New Orleans, Louisiana.

[Publication] March 2025 — Paper accepted in *Aeolian Research*, Lagging behind: Impact of non-native gravel within a coastal dune system. [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aeolia.2024.100957](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aeolia.2024.100957)
